title: Endowment · Bank branch · Deposit confusion
focus: Check whether the client was diverted from a fixed-deposit renewal into an endowment, and whether they understand it's insurance from an insurer, not a bank deposit: bonuses aren't guaranteed and early surrender loses money.
roleplay_tips: Say you went to the bank to renew your fixed deposit
Say you thought the bank guarantees the money
Say you may need the money in 2 years for your son's university
